record.paper_title: Higher Rank Brill-Noether Theory and Coherent Systems: Open Questions
record.context_brief: Bounds on sections in coherent systems
record.original_question: Find a good upper bound, either depending on alpha or independent of alpha, for the number of sections h^0(E) when (E,V) is an alpha-stable coherent system of type (n,d,k).

evidence.quote: Question 8.2. Find a good bound (either dependent on or independent of α) for h0(E) when (E, V ) ∈ G(α; n, d, k).

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let X be a smooth irreducible complex projective curve of genus g ≥ 2. A coherent system of type (n,d,k) on X is a pair (E,V), where E is an algebraic vector bundle on X of rank n and degree d, and V ⊆ H^0(E) is a linear subspace of dimension k. For a real parameter α > 0, define the α-slope of a coherent system (E,V) of type (n,d,k) by

  μ_α(E,V) = d/n + α·k/n.

A coherent system (E,V) is called α-stable if for every proper coherent subsystem (E',V') (i.e. E' ⊂ E a subbundle and V' = V ∩ H^0(E')) of type (n',d',k') with 0 < n' < n one has

  d'/n' + α·k'/n' < d/n + α·k/n.

Let G(α; n,d,k) denote the moduli space of α-stable coherent systems of type (n,d,k) on X.

Problem. Find a good upper bound (either depending on α, or independent of α) for h^0(E) when (E,V) ∈ G(α; n,d,k), in terms of the invariants n, d, k, g (and possibly α).
artifact.category_tag: Higher rank Brill-Noether theory / coherent systems
artifact.status_search_result: The problem is posed as an open question in the literature on higher rank Brill–Noether theory and coherent systems. Partial results exist (e.g. Clifford-type theorems for α-semistable coherent systems give bounds on k = dim V rather than on h^0(E)), but a satisfactory general upper bound for h^0(E) on G(α; n,d,k) does not appear to have been established. Recent work (2025) on stability conditions and moduli spaces of α-stable coherent systems continues to investigate related questions without resolving this one.

status_evidence.title: Stability conditions for coherent systems on Integral Curves
status_evidence.snippet: Recent (2025) work on α-stable coherent systems studying moduli and stability without producing a general bound on h^0(E).
status_evidence.claim: No general resolution found in recent literature.

status_evidence.title: Coherent Systems and Brill–Noether Theory
status_evidence.snippet: Clifford-type results bound k for α-semistable coherent systems, but bounding h^0(E) is a distinct problem.
status_evidence.claim: Only partial/related bounds (on k) are available.
